department: School of Biological Sciences / Faculty of Medicine

deadline.value: Research applications operate on a rolling basis; applicants should apply as early as possible (funding deadlines are usually at least 6 months prior to start).
deadline.quote: You should apply as early as possible if you need to secure a UK visa or if you are applying for funding or sponsorship. Deadlines for research funding are usually at least 6 months in advance of the start date.

entry_route.value: Applicants present undergraduate and (if graduated) Master's transcripts and degree certificates.
entry_route.quote:
an academic transcript of your undergraduate degree showing modules and marks achieved
an academic transcript from your Master's degree showing modules and marks achieved if you have already graduated
undergraduate degree certificate and Master's degree certificate (if you have already graduated)

supervisor.value: Applicants are required to name their proposed supervisor and speak to them prior to submitting an application.
supervisor.quote: supervisor name (you should speak to the supervisor before applying)

funding.value: Funded and competition-funded research projects cover tuition fees and stipends through competitive review.
funding.quote: For projects advertised as 'fully funded' or 'competition funded', your university fees will be paid and you will not need to apply for additional funding.

gre_subject.value: GRE Subject Test is not stated or required for Neuroscience PhD at Southampton.

notes: Postgraduate research programme (Neuroscience PhD) in the School of Biological Sciences / Faculty of Medicine at the University of Southampton.
